newsitem.title: USA: Metzler has no reason for stock decline.
newsitem.headline: Metzler has no reason for stock decline.

text.p: Metzler Group Inc said Thursday it knew of no reason for a sharp decline in its stock price.
Metzler shares closed Thursday's session off 5-5/8 at 22-3/8.
"There was no news and there have been no fundamental changes in our business," a Metzler spokeswoman told Reuters.

Metzler, which provides consulting services to utilities and energy-related companies, has seen its stock take periodic falls in recent weeks, although its chairman told Reuters earlier this month its business plan is still on track.

"With our acquisition strategy that we're beginning to deploy, I believe we'll be able to maintain our position and grow our market share," Robert Maher, Metzler's chairman, president and chief executive, said in a telephone interview.
Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp had cited concerns about a lack of acquisition activity for the recent stock price drop, although Maher dismissed those concerns.
Maher had said he planned to make some announcements on acquisitions by the end of the month.
The spokeswoman said nothing on that aspect of the business plan has changed since the March 3 interview.
